projection.kind: transverse Mercator on the origin meridian, WGS84 (src/geo/project.ts)

grid.note: cell centre (c, r): east = east0 + (c + 0.5)·spacing, north = north1 − (r + 0.5)·spacing, ground metres

level.note: the surface of inland water (ponds, pans, tanks) as the DEM measured it; 0 elsewhere

cover.note: WorldCover 2021, the commonest of nine 10 m samples per cell; sand where bare or tidal ground is brighter than 140 in sentinel-2026-02-26.png; salt pans from OSM, and inland water wet 3–9 months a year (JRC seasonality)
cover.licence: ODbL (salt pans from OpenStreetMap), with CC BY 4.0 WorldCover

buildings.record: x, z (world m, float32); length, width (dm, uint16); yaw (centiradians, int16); kind, levels (0: not mapped), important (uint8)
buildings.note: a ninth of the ordinary buildings (by a hash of their id) and every one OSM names or tags as more than a house, kept clear of each other on the 1:3 map; OSM's footprints, and Microsoft's where OSM has none
buildings.licence: ODbL (OpenStreetMap; Microsoft Global ML Building Footprints)

fields: tree height, metres (90th percentile of canopy pixels ≥ 3 m)

tide.source: Cox's Bazar gauge fit (tide-coxs-bazar.json), UHSLC h136a

licence: each layer its own: terrain and kind CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (from FABDEM V1-2), cover ODbL, canopy CC BY 4.0
